O Brasil já foi uma potência na fabricação de computadores? Neste episódio do “Além do Fato”, Mike Douglas investiga a trajetória da Prológica, a gigante nacional que dominou os escritórios brasileiros nos anos 80. Descubra a engenharia por trás dos icônicos gabinetes de poliuretano de 16 quilos, o design pós-moderno de Luciano Deviá e a audácia da engenharia reversa que criou clones como o CP 500 e o Solution 16. Entenda como uma empresa que chegou ao topo do mercado ruiu após um processo implacável de Bill Gates e a abertura econômica dos anos 90. Uma história de soberania, pirataria oficializada e o legado técnico que moldou a informática no Brasil.

text.text: Announcing Web Serial Support in Firefox

Firefox 151 for Desktop now supports the Web Serial API, enabling web applications to communicate directly with serial-connected hardware like microcontrollers and 3D printers without needing native software. This feature benefits hobbyists, educators, and developers, especially with tools like Adafruit’s CircuitPython. The Web Serial API allows JavaScript to interact with serial devices through USB or Bluetooth. Mozilla has collaborated with the open-source hardware community to ensure practical implementation, including security features like user-permission prompts. The API is not yet standardized but is under consideration by WHATWG. Users can provide feedback via Mozilla Connect or file technical issues through Mozilla’s support system.
Support for Web Serial in Firefox 151 for Desktop

Firefox can now connect directly to microcontrollers, development boards, 3D printers, power meters, and other serial-connected hardware from the web. Starting in Firefox 151 for Desktop, support for the Web Serial API allows web applications to communicate with compatible devices without requiring native software.

Web Serial compatible devices are popular among hobbyists, hardware hackers, educators, makers, and developers with use cases ranging from home automation to hardware prototyping and 3D printing. Web Serial support makes Firefox more useful for these kinds of projects.
